{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''secret Imperial detention center''' remained in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] lost control of the world. It was the home of the [[IT-3 Interrogator]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[It (IT-3 Interrogator)|"It"]], who was [[Programmer/Legends|reprogrammed]] by a [[Slicer droid/Legends|slicer droid]] to take down the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] after they established Coruscant as their base of power. "It" led a group of [[underdweller]]s in stealing a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] from New Republic [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], but was followed back to the detention center by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]], and [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawaroo]] and ultimately [[Skirmish in the secret Imperial detention center|destroyed]] by them.
